classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that total travel includes both directions and construct a convergent geometric series from paired downward and upward journeys.

content.prompt:
Mary bounces a ball, dropping it from $1.5\text{ m}$ on its first bounce.

It then rises up to $\frac{2}{5}$ of its height on each bounce.

Find the distance through which the ball travels.

answer.worked:
The ball first drops $1.5\text{ m}$ and rises $1.5\times\frac25=0.6\text{ m}$. The first downward-and-upward pair totals $2.1\text{ m}$. Each subsequent pair is $\frac25$ of the previous pair, so these distances form a GP with $a=2.1$ and $r=\frac25$.

Since $|r|<1$,
$$\begin{align*}S_\infty&=\frac{a}{1-r}\\&=\frac{2.1}{1-\frac25}\\&=\frac{21}{10}\times\frac53\\&=\frac72\\&=3.5\text{ m}.\end{align*}$$
